category_title: At-risk students in technical tracks who exhibit attention-seeking behaviors, restlessness, and kinetic learning needs
scenario_title: Teacher-directed instruction triggering restlessness and disruption
minimal_context: The student is learning basic keyboard chord playing using video demonstrations and handouts in a keyboard lab.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please watch this video demonstration on how to play the chords on the keyboard, and read the handout with the letter names so you know what keys to play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Cannot stop touching the keyboard) Miss, Miss, how to play?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just listen to the instructions and follow along with the video.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes restless and opens a PC game on the computer) I'm having a hard time following the chord changes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please close the game and pay attention to the instructions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Decides to play the keyboard really loudly) I don't want to listen to instructions!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please watch this video demonstration on how to play the chords on the keyboard, and read the handout with the letter names so you know what keys to play.

STUDENT: (Cannot stop touching the keyboard) Miss, Miss, how to play?

TUTOR: Just listen to the instructions and follow along with the video.

STUDENT: (Becomes restless and opens a PC game on the computer) I'm having a hard time following the chord changes.

TUTOR: Please close the game and pay attention to the instructions.

STUDENT: (Decides to play the keyboard really loudly) I don't want to listen to instructions!

task.content: Learning basic keyboard chord playing using video demonstrations and handouts illustrating a keyboard with corresponding letter names
task.learning_goal: so that students would know what keys to play

context.materials: keyboard, computer, video demonstrations, handouts illustrating a keyboard with corresponding letter names, box notation, SONAR software
context.time_context: At the beginning of the trialling when providing grounding

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: being required to listen to instructions
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: cannot stop himself touching the keyboard... decided to play the keyboard really loudly
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: releasing their energies on the music as opposed to being required to listen to instructions

behavior_patterns.condition: When the students had a hard time following the chord changes
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: started to become restless and some played PC games on their computers
